# DD2 Ceiling Fan

link: <https://community.homey.app/t/dd2-ceiling-fan/128904>

## Description

This is a person trying to control the ceilingfan with Homey

## Remote

DD2

## Button mapping

From the followup post:

| Button | Code | Key |
| ------ | ---- | --- |
| Light on | 0xC08 | K4 |
| Light off | 0xC20 | K6 |
| Fan off | 0xC10 | K5 |
| Fan speed 1 | 0xC43 | K7 |
| Fan speed 2 | 0xC04 | K3 |
| Fan speed 3 | 0xC01 | K1 |

## Protocol insights

These captures match the Symphony 12-bit protocol format.

- Header: `110`
- Custom code: `00`
- Each command includes START_A (`0x00`) and START_B (`0x7F`) frames before the command frame
